findings.F1: The book's gain is mostly the market's rise, held through a few large long trades. Its mean daily return is 0.1232 % (t 3.14, 2898 days), of which 0.0554 % is the market's own rise and 0.0678 % is timing, against 0.1179 % for holding the coins. Without its best 5 % of days the mean falls to −0.1614 %. Without its best 5 % of trades, the net sum of 12353 % becomes −665 %.
findings.F2: The book earns from long holds of weeks, not from the plan's 3 days. The 860 trades held over 14 days carry 10219 % of the 12353 % net sum, and trades of 3 to 7 days earn 0.02 % each. The mean trade lasts 243 hours, and 70 % of entries are at the forecast's cap of 20.
findings.F3: The book earns where the 30-day return is positive, but mostly away from the dip itself. Bars with a positive 30-day return carry 73 % of the position's gain, at a mean position of 0.85 against 0.14 when the 30-day return is not positive. Inside those up states, bars with a 24-hour fall of at least one usual daily move carry only 28 % of the gain, against 41 % for bars without such a fall.
findings.F4: The idea's situation is real when read on the plain grid, and graded by the depth of the fall. With a positive 30-day return, the 72-hour unusual move by depth of the 24-hour fall (in multiples of the 30-day mean absolute 24-hour return) is:
findings.F5: The same falls when the 30-day return is not positive are followed by no rebound. Falls of at least one usual daily move give +0.09 % over 72 hours (t 0.23, 421 cases), and falls of at least two give +0.66 % (t 1.0, 146 cases). Falls of at least two in an uptrend give +2.94 % (t 4.12, 86 cases).
findings.F6: The idea's second grading, by the strength of the month's rise, is not there. Among uptrend dips of at least one usual daily move, the 72-hour unusual move by tercile of the 30-day return in its usual size is +1.51 %, +3.98 % and −0.22 % from weakest to strongest (Spearman −0.086, p 0.16, 263 cases).
findings.F7: The rebound shows within a day, peaks over 3 days and is gone by 2 weeks. For uptrend dips of at least one usual daily move, the unusual move is:
findings.F8: Acting at the hour the situation first holds earns no more than acting at that day's close. The 72-hour unusual move is +0.44 % from onset and +0.47 % from the daily close, a difference of −0.02 % (t −0.19, 1760 cases, mean lag 12 hours). This is the brief's own refutation condition.
findings.F9: The plan's supporting check could not run, and the book's forecast barely grades the move at its horizon. All 2803 cases sat at or below the median entry forecast because the forecast is capped at 20. By tercile of the raw value at onset, the 72-hour unusual move is −0.05 %, +0.26 % and +0.88 %, but the raw value's Spearman with the 72-hour move is only 0.025 (p 0.16).
findings.F10: The book's own cases follow the market's years. The 72-hour unusual move of its cases is −1.16 % in 2018 and −0.95 % in 2022, against +1.48 % in 2020 and +1.15 % in 2021. Uptrend dips on the grid go from −2.58 % in 2018 to +4.22 % in 2021.
findings.F11: A plain month-long rise predicts the next 3 days only weakly. Across all grid cells, the top two quintiles of the 30-day return give a 72-hour unusual move of +0.35 % and +0.40 % (t 1.34 and 1.10, 820 cases each). The bottom quintiles give −0.09 % and −0.51 %.

ideas.idea: When a coin's 30-day return is positive, the deeper its 24-hour fall in multiples of its 30-day average absolute daily return, the more the coin rises above its normal drift over the next 3 days.
ideas.consequence: A sharp one-day drop inside a month-long rise is a reason to buy for about 3 days, sized by the depth of the drop rather than by the strength of the month.
ideas.name: dip depth in uptrend rebounds

ideas.idea: When a coin's 30-day return is positive, the larger that return in multiples of its usual 30-day move, the more the coin rises above its normal drift over the next 2 weeks.
ideas.consequence: A strong month-long rise is a reason to stay long for weeks, which is the hold this book actually profits from.
ideas.name: monthly rise carries for weeks
